architecture_principle: Retrieval iteration must ACCUMULATE information state, never replace earlier context with the latest bridge. Pinned by tests/unit/test_information_state.py.
environment_note: Installing FlagEmbedding downgraded transformers to 4.57.6, and the HRM adapter's pinned-version guard refused to load rather than silently using a different architecture. FlagEmbedding is removed; transformers restored to 5.14.1. The guard did exactly its job.

gate_c1_v4_ladder.claim: On frozen controlled_gate_a_v4 with the mechanism pinned at 3260ce0, the current retrieval path is near-inert: R1 two-pass reaches 0.062 qualification / 0.016 OOD against an oracle-evidence ceiling of 0.880 / 0.908.
gate_c1_v4_ladder.critical_reading_of_R3_to_R4: R4's complete-set success is only 0.168 while its quality is 0.462, so R4 answers many tasks from PARTIAL gold evidence. The +0.408 gain is therefore not 'better ranking' -- it is the effect of removing every non-gold record. Any distractor in the packet is close to catastrophic, and the reader can often work from an incomplete but clean packet. Do not read R3->R4 as a pure selection-ranking term.

gate_c2_bge_dense.claim: A stronger pinned dense encoder (BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5, CLS pooling, query-prefix only) earns promotion on OOD but not on qualification. Complete-set@50 rises 0.072 -> 0.152 OOD (more than doubling) while qualification moves only 0.364 -> 0.370.
gate_c2_bge_dense.claim_class_note: The numbers stand (BGE OOD CES@50 0.152 vs MiniLM 0.072; description 0.083 -> 0.242). But this OOD set has now been used to decide whether BGE belongs in the architecture, so it is no longer a pristine final confirmation set for THIS C2 architecture-selection question. Class changed from 'final untouched confirmation' to 'measured exploratory evidence used for architecture selection'. A clean confirmation requires controlled_gate_c2_calibration_v1.
gate_c2_bge_dense.description_component_caveat: The +0.14/+0.159 description gains were measured on the ambiguous corpus. They may show that BGE retrieves semantically related text better, but they do NOT establish entity-level description handling and must not be cited as such until reproduced on an identifiable corpus.
gate_c2_bge_dense.interpretation: The entire OOD gain comes from the DESCRIPTION regime (+0.158, roughly 3x). That is mechanistically coherent: a description is a natural-language phrase, which is what a semantic encoder is for. An alias is an arbitrary name substitution that no encoder can resolve without retrieving the identity record, so alias remains a multi-hop retrieval problem rather than an embedding problem. Promoting BGE on aggregate recall alone would have obscured that split.
not_a_claim_about: qualification, where the gain is +0.006 and within noise
alias resolution, which improves only +0.008 and is not a semantic-similarity problem
downstream answer quality, which was not measured here
gate_c2_bge_dense.promotion_wording: bge-small-en-v1.5 is promoted as the preferred dense representation for semantic-description OOD retrieval in V4 and as a candidate dense arm for Gate C2 fusion. NOT 'the best retriever'.

gate_c2_description_diagnostic.claim: Staged funnel over all 150 description tasks. Identity retrieval, mention recognition, and resolver response are all 1.000; canonical correctness is 0.00-0.12. ResolutionRate 1.000 with ResolutionPrecision 0.00-0.12, dominant class AMBIGUOUS_MATCH. Root cause: only 4 descriptor phrases exist per corpus, so one description string refers to up to 13 different entities and the question does not identify a unique referent.
gate_c2_description_diagnostic.consequence: The v3 description verdict measured an ill-posed regime, not a mechanism limitation. The oracle arm reached 1.000 only by reading true canonical identity from _oracle_metadata, bypassing an ambiguity no runtime resolver can resolve. All description-regime figures in C2-C-v1/v2/v3 and the description component of the BGE policy comparison are VOIDED as mechanism measurements. Canonical, abbreviation, and alias are unaffected.

Development therefore CANNOT select for the capability BGE provides, and freezing the retriever on development alone would discard it for the wrong reason. gate_c2_policy_arms.alias_decomposition_overturns_the_prior_: I predicted in advance that alias would fail because no arm traverses an identity record. The decomposition says otherwise: identity_record_recall is 0.96-1.00 on the surface partition, so identity records ARE being retrieved. The shortfall is target_recall_given_identity_found at 0.61-0.80, and complete-set at only 0.21-0.26. The bottleneck is assembling the COMPLETE multi-record proof path after identity is in hand, not finding the identity record. This reframes C2-I from 'identity resolution' toward chain completion.

gate_c2_policy_arms.replication: BGE's description advantage REPLICATES on a fresh corpus with fully disjoint vocabulary (+0.14 alone, +0.08 in fusion), so it is a real property of the regime rather than a V4 artifact. That is the strongest positive result here, even though the arm fails.

gate_c2_query_ladder.claim: Q0-Q3 retrieval-only query ablation on frozen V4. Querying the bridge entity ALONE (Q1) is worse than the original question on both splits and collapses to 0.000 complete-set@50 on OOD, which explains why the V4 ladder's R2 did not beat R1. A fully rendered request (Q3) nearly doubles dense complete-set@10 on qualification (0.214 -> 0.416) and lifts fusion complete-set@50 from 0.426 to 0.614. On OOD even a perfect query reaches only 0.200, so retrieval representation, not query formulation, is the binding constraint there.
gate_c2_query_ladder.implication: Query formulation is a real opportunity on qualification but is NOT sufficient on OOD. Building a semantic gap reasoner alone would sit on top of an index that cannot exploit a perfect query out of distribution. Retrieval representation must improve alongside it.
not_a_claim_about: downstream answer quality, which was not measured in this ablation
any learned query formulator, since Q1-Q3 are oracle-constructed

gate_c2c_chain_completion.claim: Bounded runtime chain completion produces large gains on the primary metric but fails a secondary conditional criterion that I specified badly. All four runtime arms clear five of six predeclared checks and fail only target_recall_given_identity_delta.
gate_c2c_chain_completion.mechanism_finding: Chain completion is highly effective. On c2_cal_id complete-set rises 0.710 -> 0.980, essentially reaching the 1.000 oracle-evidence ceiling. On c2_cal_surface it rises 0.260 -> 0.560. Alias improves +0.42 and abbreviation +0.52 against a required +0.10, with zero canonical regression and depth within the bound of 2. Canonicalization is purely runtime: identity statements are parsed out of retrieved candidate text, never read from _oracle_metadata.
gate_c2c_chain_completion.my_specification_error: Choosing a near-saturated conditional metric as a REQUIRED promotion criterion was a protocol-design mistake, made by me before the run. The correct response is not to move the bar after seeing results -- that would destroy the value of predeclaring. The verdict stands as FAIL. A successor protocol must predeclare criteria with measurable headroom, and these numbers are then exploratory with respect to that successor.
not_a_claim_about: promotion; the frozen bar was not met and is not being moved
the holdout partition, untouched
downstream HRM quality, not measured
gate_c2c_chain_completion.semantics_note: experiment_verdict FAIL means the predeclared promotion criterion was not met. It does NOT mean the mechanism had no effect; mechanism_effect_observed is true and large. Historical verdicts are unchanged; the status model is now expressive enough to hold both facts at once.
gate_c2c_chain_completion.verdict: FAIL_CHAIN_COMPLETION under the frozen protocol, on one criterion only
gate_c2c_chain_completion.why_it_fails: target_recall_given_identity_delta required >= +0.05. Measured: C1 +0.0144, C2 -0.0857, C3 -0.0143, C4 +0.0469. The reference already scored 0.96 on c2_cal_id and 0.80 on c2_cal_surface for that metric, so at most 0.20 of headroom existed and I still required +0.05 of it as a hard gate. C4 misses by 0.0031.

gate_c2c_v2_chain_validation.the_reformulated_criterion_worked: v1's ill-posed absolute +0.05 on a near-saturated diagnostic is replaced by headroom closure, and it PASSED at 0.192. The reformulation was correct and is now validated on data it was not fitted to.

gate_c2c_v2_chain_validation.what_failed_and_why_it_is_not_the_mechan: description +0.08 vs required +0.10. Chain completion helps description least because a description question already resolves through one identity record; it has the shortest residual chain, so there is least for a follow-up to recover. The +0.10 bar was carried over from the policy-arm protocol where it measured a DIFFERENT intervention (a stronger encoder). Reusing an encoder-calibrated threshold for a chain-completion endpoint is a second protocol-specification error, distinct from v1's.

gate_c2c_v3_chain_validation.the_normalizer_worked: Oracle-gap closure was the right endpoint and it changed the diagnosis rather than merely the arithmetic. Under v2's absolute deltas, description looked like a near-miss (+0.08 vs +0.10). Normalized, it is a near-total failure: 0.025 of an available 0.800. The two prior protocols were hiding the single regime where the mechanism genuinely does not work.
gate_c2c_v3_chain_validation.what_this_isolates: Chain completion is real and large for abbreviation and alias -- where a retrieved identity record names a canonical entity that runtime parsing can extract. Description references resolve through prose ('the ancillary unit charted during survey season'), and the canonicalization parser recovers them far less reliably, so the follow-up query is built from a subject it never resolved. C5 reaching 1.000 proves the evidence is retrievable given the right query, so this is a canonicalization-coverage failure, not a retrieval-ceiling failure.

gate_c2s_relation_keyword_control.claim: The arm labelled S2_connectivity computes exactly as implemented but does not instantiate the chain-selection hypothesis it was built for. Its dominant term rewards records containing the target relation string. In this corpus 0/56 bridge records contain the target relation while 99/99 answer records do, so the arm cannot retain a bridge record: BridgeRetention=0.000 is arithmetically forced, not incidental. It fills 91.3% of each packet with relation-string matches, of which 79.3% of the packet are relation-matching records that are not required.
gate_c2s_relation_keyword_control.distinguished_from: the ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2 arm, which was COMPUTATIONALLY invalid (NaN scores). This arm computes correctly; only its scientific interpretation was wrong. Its receipts are valid and retained.

gate_c2s_relation_keyword_control.kept_as: negative control: target-relation keyword matching is insufficient for multi-hop packing and causes systematic distractor selection

gate_c2s_relation_keyword_control.retained_because: On descv4_surface it is the only arm with a significant gain (+0.170, CI excluding zero under all three groupings, SGC 30.9%). Relation scoring needs no entity anchor, so it still works where identity resolution fails. It is a useful fallback baseline for weak-identity conditions, not a bad implementation to forget.

gate_c2s_selection_opportunity.why_conditional_metrics_matter: Retrieval is not being blamed for selection. Complete evidence is AVAILABLE in the pool for 0.95 and 0.74 of tasks, yet raw top-N retains it for only 0.46 and 0.22 of those available cases. The gap is selection discarding evidence the retriever already found.

gate_c2s_selector_arm_defect.claim: The first S3 cross-encoder arm was dead and silently reported the baseline. cross-encoder/ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2 returns NaN from its first attention layer onward for every query/document pair under torch 2.10 / transformers 5.14.1, with finite fp32 weights (absmax 4.7) and clean embeddings. Python compares NaN sort keys as all-False, so the pool came back unreordered and the arm produced metrics identical to S0 to four decimals.

diagnosis_evidence.model_specific: ms-marco-MiniLM-L-12-v2 scores +7.52 relevant / -11.14 irrelevant and TinyBERT-L-2-v2 scores +6.92 / -11.42 on the same stack, so the defect is the L6 checkpoint, not the environment or the harness

gate_c2s_selector_arm_defect.fix: Added DegenerateRerankerError: a reranker returning any non-finite score, or one score for every candidate, now raises instead of emitting an order that duplicates the raw pool. Runs also record differs_from_s0 per arm, so a no-op arm is visible in the receipt. S3 is repinned to ms-marco-MiniLM-L-12-v2 at a fixed revision.

gate_c2s_selector_arm_defect.voided: The earlier partial descv4_id figures are void: they came from an uncommitted /tmp script that wrote no manifest before timing out, and they included the dead S3 arm. They are not carried forward as evidence.
gate_c2s_selector_arm_defect.why_it_mattered: Read naively, that arm said 'cross-encoder reranking does not help', which would have been a false negative about a component the roadmap depends on. The arm had not reranked anything.

gate_c2s_selector_ladder_budget6.ablation: relation-only retains answers but destroys bridges (BridgeRetention 0.000); structure-only (S2b) retains bridges but collapses answer retention to 0.394 and LOSES quality (dQ=-0.100); structure plus relation as one component is the only combination that improves both and the only one that moves quality.

ceilings.note: S5 is the ceiling for SELECTION over the frozen candidate pool. It is not the pipeline ceiling and must not be conflated with R5-style oracle-evidence arms, which bypass more of the pipeline.

gate_c2s_selector_ladder_budget6.claim: At packet budget 6 over the frozen pools, oracle selection is worth +0.390 quality on descv4_id (0.360 -> 0.750) and +0.550 on descv4_surface (0.130 -> 0.680), so evidence selection is a real and large lever. Of the runtime arms, only S2c_chain_plus_relation separates from S0 on descv4_id: dQ=+0.1200 with a paired grouped-bootstrap CI excluding zero under ALL THREE groupings (family [0.04,0.21], source_cluster [0.030,0.214], template [0.010,0.228]), capturing 30.8% of the oracle opportunity. S1/S2/S3/S4 and S2a/S2b do not separate from S0 on that partition.
gate_c2s_selector_ladder_budget6.dual_mechanism_note: S2c appears to help through two distinct routes -- structural role recovery and packet cleanliness / distractor reduction -- which the current single score conflates. A future structural selector should make those terms explicit rather than fusing them.
gate_c2s_selector_ladder_budget6.earned_claim: S2c improves evidence selection when the question entity can be resolved.
gate_c2s_selector_ladder_budget6.mechanism_evidence: Correct->wrong flips attribute pointwise failures to role loss: S1 loses the identity record on 10 of 13, S3 the answer record on 10 of 16, S4 answer on 8 and identity on 4 of 13. S2c's 22 fixes break down as 14 answer newly retained, 8 bridge newly retained, 7 both jointly, 15 with distractors reduced, and 7 with no new role retained -- so the gain is partly the intended structural recovery and partly a cleaner packet, NOT purely the claimed mechanism.
not_a_claim_about: packet budgets other than 6, which were not swept
S2b/S2c behaviour on surface forms, where they were inert and unmeasured
promotion of any selector into the default pipeline

gate_c2s_selector_ladder_budget6.not_earned_claim: S2c is the production selector for all V4 regimes.
gate_c2s_selector_ladder_budget6.surface_partition_defect: S2b and S2c are INERT on descv4_surface: differs_from_s0=0.00 on every task. Question subjects there are truncated surface forms ('Ojos tension' vs canonical 'Ojos tension block'), so entity extraction yields no question entity on 100/100 tasks, no chains are enumerated, and packing falls back to pool order. Their surface figures are S0 replayed and are NOT measurements of those arms.
gate_c2s_selector_ladder_budget6.uncomfortable_result: On descv4_surface the rescoped relation-keyword control is the only arm with a significant gain: dQ=+0.1700, CI excluding zero under all three groupings, SGC 30.9%. It needs no entity extraction, so it still works where identity resolution fails. This does not rehabilitate it as a chain selector -- its BridgeRetention is 0.000 on descv4_id -- but it is not merely an artifact either.

testing_policy: Tests assert structured state, never exact strings against narrative prose. Three separate failures came from matching capitalisation in text written separately from the assertion; the pattern was wrong, not merely careless. Prose is rendered from state, and state is what is tested.

verdict_semantics.experiment_verdict: whether the predeclared promotion criterion was met
verdict_semantics.mechanism_effect_observed: whether a real effect was measured, independent of promotion
verdict_semantics.rule: A FAIL verdict never implies absence of effect. Both are recorded separately.
